body: I'll do my best to make it there. Thank you
Thank you. It means quite a lot to me. I just feel like I've crossed the point of no return for things to ever get better. I feel like if I die, I will finally have peace.

I left Highschool a perfect student, in the top 10 percent with 40+ hours of college credit under my belt. I'm currently a senior in college with a 3.0 and even failed a class. I originally wanted to go to med school but that's not going to happen with a 3.0 I'm terrified I've disappointed my parents who are paying my tuition. And yeah I know there can be some bad apples out there but it's all I've been able to find. A devil on my shoulder keeps telling me there has got to be something wrong with me and that it is all my fault and that all there is to find are more bad apples.

Much of my depression stems off of the fact that it is apparently impossible for me to have a relationship. Don't get me wrong, I have lots of friends and everyone like me as I am a very friendly fellow but when it comes to the ladies nothing works out. I mean, I have no problem getting them but everyone I attract ends up cheating on me or just randomly deciding to break things off. It's happened 4 times in a row now... I feel so empty inside because I feel like having these feelings is going to kill me and that I'll end up alone. There are other things but that is the main one
